Package client

Class RestaurantWorkerController

java.lang.Object
client.RestaurantWorkerController
public class RestaurantWorkerController extends Object
The RestaurantWorkerController class is responsible for managing the restaurant worker's view in the application. It handles the display and management of orders for a specific restaurant, allowing the worker to update the status of orders and view the details of each order.
